Pydantic v2 applies the pattern with search semantics, so the explicit ^...$ anchors make it a full match. Pydantic-core's default Rust regex engine treats $ as end-of-text only, so a trailing newline does not slip through. The patterns use explicit [0-9] ranges, so non-ASCII digits are rejected. A leading-zero ID like '01' fails the (0|[1-9][0-9]*) alternation, and a non-digit or a name starting with a digit fails its pattern. StrictStr accepts only str instances, and tomllib returns datetime.date for a TOML date, so it is rejected as a wrong type. The _Record base model also sets strict=True (line 78).
